worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.summary: Lay fallen allies to rest: ghost-wisps rise from the ground and march with you to the foe, carrying one heavy strike. The more allies of your side that have fallen, the more wisps and the heavier the blow; the trail form sweeps a corridor, the send-off form gathers on a single target.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.use.0: Strike for allies that have fallen
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.use.1: Sweep a corridor clear with the trail form
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.use.2: Send one target far with a single heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.descripti: The strike deals %1$s damage; each ally of your side that has fallen this battle adds 50 (up to +250), currently %2$s fallen.
Marches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, sweeps a %3$s block half-width, and shoves the target %4$s blocks.
Raises %1$s ghost-wisps at the start and along the way; more fallen allies means more who walk with you.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.trail.on: Trail form: the wisps follow the path, turning the strike into a corridor that catches everyone on it (x0.85 each), wider and with +4 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.trail.off: Send-off form: the wisps gather at one point for a single target, x1.1 on the blow, a stronger shove and a faster rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s committed cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.growth.0: From level %1$s: strike power %2$s, march distance %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.growth.1: From level %1$s: strike power %2$s, distance %3$s blocks, %4$s ghost-wisps.
worldcombat.skill.lastrespects.preferenc: On (trail): the wisps follow the path and the strike becomes a corridor catching everyone on it (x0.85 each), wider with +4 cooldown - good for clearing a lane. Off (send-off): the wisps gather on one point for one target, x1.1 on the blow, a stronger shove and a faster rhythm.

Within this distance it is willing to march in with the strike; beyond it the priority drops low (the shared approach still walks it in). It has to cover ground before the blow, so a larger value only starts it a little sooner.
On: each ally of your side that has fallen raises the priority - sending them off is exactly this move's moment. Off: ignore the fallen record and rank it as an ordinary close-range attack.
